# Why Bodhisattva is spelled that way — and what it costs to get it right

There is a version of this name the early internet had to settle for: *boddhisattva*. This is the file on how **Bodhisattva** replaced it.

The stories of Bodhisattva place enlightenment being, compassion at the center of a living mythological world.

## At a Glance

- **Restored name:** Bodhisattva
- **ASCII form:** boddhisattva
- **Meaning:** "'Awakening-being' — one who vows Buddhahood for the sake of all beings"
- **Domain of influence:** Enlightenment Being, Compassion
- **Pantheon:** Buddhist
- **Classification:** Tier 2
- **Original script:** बोधिसत्त्व
- **Series:** The Restoration Files, No. 88 of 542

## The Name Before the Marks


Spoken, the name runs `/boddhisattva/` — say "boddhisattva" with the stress and length implied by the scholarly restoration "Bodhisattva".

## The Temple That Stands Now

The restored name is not a plaque; it is an address. The temple of **Bodhisattva** lives at [/boddhisattva/](/boddhisattva/), with its mythology in the [lore halls](/boddhisattva/lore/), its peer-reviewed record in the [Scholarly Edition](/boddhisattva/scholars/), and its place in the pattern atlas on the [patterns floor](/boddhisattva/patterns/).

Tier-2 here means one preserved truth — not less important, just singular. The temple shows it and names it.

## The Archetype at Work

The [pattern atlas](/patterns/) seats this temple in **4 industries**, each match argued and weighted: **Faith & Spiritual Organizations** (primary seat: Bodhisattva embodies enlightenment being, compassion — the core of faith.); **Mental Health & Emotional Wellness** (resonant seat: Bodhisattva shares symbolic territory with mental health.); **Philosophy, Ethics & Standards** (resonant seat: Bodhisattva shares symbolic territory with philosophy ethics.). The [Resonance File](/boddhisattva/blog/resonance/) reads those seats through the myths themselves.

## In the Sacred Texts

The Buddhist tradition is not a vibe; it is a library. The [Sacred Texts collection](/texts/) holds [Lotus Sutra](/texts/lotus-sutra/) and [Sukhāvatīvyūha Sūtras](/texts/sukhavativyuha/) — the primary sources the temple's scholarship is built on. The temple is the argument; the texts are the evidence.

## The Emblems

The name does not travel alone. **Name** — The restored form Bodhisattva, carrying scholarly and cultural weight.; **Domain** — Enlightenment Being, Compassion. Each emblem is filed in the temple's record with its own provenance, the same discipline the spelling gets.

## For the Voice

Say "boddhisattva" with the stress and length implied by the scholarly restoration "Bodhisattva". The reconstructed line runs `/boddhisattva/` — the temple's pronunciation atlas carries the phonemes one by one.

## The Discipline It Answers To

This restoration belongs to Buddhist, a tradition with its own exact discipline. The rules that govern it are not house style; they are the tradition's own scholarship, applied with the same care here as in any edition — and published, with the sources, so the file can be checked the way an edition can be checked. Tier-2 here means one preserved truth — not less important, just singular. The temple shows it and names it.
